output.objection: I did not ask you to skip the dedicated drift tool because it is too expensive. I asked you to acknowledge that I am willing to build an in-house script as a fallback if the budget truly cannot cover the licensed solution.
output.correction: You are misreading my position as a cost-cutting demand when it is actually a clear preference hierarchy. I want the dedicated tool first, and the in-house script is only my concession if we hit a hard budget wall.
